text:
```yaml
name: Rust Workflow

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  rust-windows:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      
      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          profile: minimal
          override: true
      
      - name: Build project
        run: cargo build --release
      
      - name: Package assets
        run: |
          mkdir -p target/release/assets
          cp path/to/assets/* target/release/assets/
      
      - name: Upload artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v2
        with:
          name: rust-windows-artifacts
          path: target/release/

  rust-web:
    needs: rust-windows
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Download artifacts from rust-windows job
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v2
        with:
          name: rust-windows-artifacts
      
      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          profile: minimal
          override: true
      
      - name: Install wasm-pack
        run: cargo install wasm-pack
      
      - name: Build WASM
        run: |
          cd path/to/web-project
          wasm-pack build --target web
      
      - name: Upload WASM artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v2
        with:
          name: rust-web-wasm
          path: path/to/web-project/pkg/

  deploy:
    needs: rust-web
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Download WASM artifact
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v2
        with:
          name: rust-web-wasm
      
      - name: Deploy to server
        run: |
          # Add deployment commands here
          echo "Deploying to server..."
```

This GitHub Actions workflow separates the original `rust.yml` workflow into three parts: `rust-windows.yml`, `rust-web.yml`, and `deploy.yml`. The `rust-windows.yml` job builds the Rust project for Windows and packages any necessary assets. It then uploads these artifacts. The `rust-web.yml` job waits for the completion of `rust-windows.yml`, downloads the artifacts, sets up Rust, installs `wasm-pack`, and builds the WASM project. Finally, the `deploy.yml` job waits for `rust-web.yml` to complete, downloads the WASM artifact, and performs the deployment process.
